rootCause: The `archivy` package's dependencies (Flask/Werkzeug) are incompatible with Python 3.14 (system default on Ubuntu 26.04), causing an `ast.Str` AttributeError; the codebase requires an older Python version (3.8 or 3.7) and `setuptools<81` for `pkg_resources`.
patch:
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -23,11 +23,24 @@ Upcoming:
 
 ## Quickstart
 
-Install archivy with `pip install archivy`. Other installations methods are listed [here](https://archivy.github.io/install), including Docker.
+Archivy currently requires Python 3.8 or 3.7. On Ubuntu, install Python 3.8 with:
+
+```bash
+sudo apt-get update
+sudo apt-get install -y software-properties-common
+sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:deadsnakes/ppa
+sudo apt-get update
+sudo apt-get install -y python3.8 python3.8-venv
+```
+
+Then create a virtual environment and install archivy with:
+
+```bash
+python3.8 -m venv ~/venv
+source ~/venv/bin/activate
+pip install "setuptools<81" archivy
+```
+
+Other installations methods are listed [here](https://archivy.github.io/install), including Docker.
 
 Run the `archivy init` command to setup you installation.
